text.p: Roosevelt Financial Group Inc said Thursday it has acquired $750 million of mortgage servicing rights, and expects the deal to close before the end of the year.
The purchase will expand the company's portfolio by about 10 percent. Roosevelt said it anticipates it will begin 1997 with more than $8 billion in mortgages.
Roosevelt also reiterated that third and fourth quarter net earnings will likely be flat compared with last year. It issued an initial statement cautioning investors in July.
"Despite a lot of things going on, we don't expect anything but flatness," a spokesman for the company said.
In a release, Roosevelt said in July and August it issued a total of 72,469 credit cards carrying balances of $28 million as of August 31.
It also said retail activities in July and August grew, with mortgages and consumer loans up $196 million and $38 million, respectively, and 22,735 new checking accounts opened.
